_about: Beat judge limits (tools/evfx beats). Frames are 60 fps. Numbers marked bible come from SE370's docs/motion-bible.md; the others from the Lotus and Frigid dissection (docs/refs).

keywords.snappy: the hit beat comes on within snapRise frames and its flash holds flashFrames
keywords.punchy: the camera jolts within shakeWithin frames of the hit
keywords.crisp: every key beat stays on screen keyFrames frames and comes on within crispRise
keywords.heavy: something tells the wind-up, and the tail runs past the recovery
keywords.committed: the tail runs to the end of the recovery
keywords.clean recovery: the tail is gone within cleanAfter seconds of the recovery's end
